canonical_project: Bauhaus-Universitaet Weimar SCC / Konrad-Zuse-Medienhaus computing center
notes: Official university SCC page identifies the Servicezentrum fuer Computersysteme und -kommunikation as the university IT service center at Steubenstrasse 6a, 99423 Weimar, responsible for central campus IT services including virtual servers and hosting. Architecture sources document the conversion of the former Stadtbrauerei building into the university computing center and Faculty of Media, completed in 2002, with about 778.7 sqm identified as Rechenzentrum space; no MW capacity disclosed.
